description: This file defines the ProjectReport class, which implements the EndpointAwareReport interface. It manages the preparation of filter parameters, validation rules, report header and filter definitions, and data retrieval for project reports within the OrangeHRM time management plugin. The class includes methods for checking report access permissions as well.

classes.name: ProjectReport
classes.description: The ProjectReport class handles the generation of project time reports, including filter preparation, validation, report structure, and data fetching, with integrated permissions check.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares filtering parameters from the endpoint request, including project ID and date range.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Provides validation rules for incoming request parameters to ensure proper filter data.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the report's header columns, including labels and styling.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Provides the filter configuration for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on the specified filter parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the report; throws ForbiddenException if not.
